_comment: 'The next Runeblade or Lightning attack action card gets go again' is the one-shot grant. The second sentence ('your next 3 attacks this turn get +1{p} while they have go again') is a conditional buff on three attacks and is NOT modelled — the queue holds one-shots, not counted multi-attack effects with a per-attack condition. Omitted rather than approximated as three flat +1s, which would buff attacks that do not have go again.
